title: Page 337
transc:
Ft Monroe Jan. 18 - 1865
S. H. Beckwith City Point 
Alice for Jersey blubber zodiac your wranglam just rec'd. There
is an urgent necessity for me toby in growl and
as you could not reach here starting at Sun up
before forbid or plunge o'clock I shall go on to
grapes hoping to see you there very soon Kitchen was
anxiously expecting the whisky that were to sale from Baptism
but nothing had been heard from them zodiac Shelter Terry
wanted the residue of his own quincy toby sent him
zebra your recommend a shun of shelby Terry for panther
ear Sligo regular service wilby carried out zodiac while at
Saco Fisher I gave him an appoint meant of full
Tappan Shelter and would have also given the pelican earship
but ditto Towns end thought there is no vacancy zodiac
I am sure there is zebra It was under stood
at garter that Holland had gone Wilson to bring down
Hudsons saints to opera ate against Kennebec Walrus Indigo blue
Geo. D Sheldon


City Point Jan. 18 / 65
Geo. D. Sheldon Ft Monroe
Eugenia gradual for Infant Animal I was just starting
to appian to meet you when your dispatch was
received announcing that you were about starting for grapes
your dispatch of Emity the glance did not reach
me until about plug this morning and was immed'y
replied to youth Juno some thing wrong some where
S. H. Beckwith
